capabilities: Render math in HTML table cells with MathJax
Support inline and display dollar-sign delimiters plus escaped dollar signs
Leave plain text and unbalanced dollar signs untouched
Toggle rendering in Live Preview separately from Reading View
Choose fallback behavior for formulas that fail to render
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer because the plugin uses the declarative settings API; installable from the community catalog or manually from GitHub releases.
intentEvidence: Obsidian renders $...$ math in regular markdown, but not inside raw HTML tables. This plugin fills that gap
problem: Obsidian's math rendering skips raw HTML tables, so $...$ formulas typed in td/th cells stay as plain text.

relations.evidence: math in <table> cells is rendered with MathJax in both Reading View and Live Preview

summary: Renders LaTeX math ($...$ and $$...$$) inside raw HTML table cells using MathJax, in Reading View and optionally Live Preview.
